description: Pre/post tool interceptors — Superior OS v2.0 (deve 4 hooks + post-tool linter).

pre_tool_hooks.description: Runs pre_tool_guard.py before every tool execution. Blocks dangerous patterns.
ABAC Class-3 gate: denies git_push_main, drop_database, terraform_apply_production, publish_package without approval+token.
Requires [Y/n] human confirmation before file writes, git commits, deploys.
Fatal error if identical tool+args called twice consecutively. Prevents Infinite Agentic Loops.
pre_tool_hooks.message: IAL guard triggered: identical tool call repeated. Handing control back to developer.

post_tool_hooks.description: Scans newly written files for hardcoded secrets immediately after write.
post_tool_hooks.message: Hardcoded secret detected in written file. Aborting. Remove the secret before proceeding.

post_tool_hooks.description: Auto-formats and AST-validates written Python files (ruff + compile).
post_tool_hooks.message: Written Python failed syntax check. Fix before proceeding.

loop_rails.message: Loop rail exceeded: max_steps=15. Handing control back to developer.
